result.final_text:
DECISION: Buy Monthly Membership
JUSTIFICATION: The rider's total pay-per-use cost is $5,104.05, while the membership total is $74.71. The break-even point is 3.1 rides per month, but the rider has 540 rides, far exceeding this threshold. The membership offers significant savings, especially with the high number of electric bike rides (414 out of 540) which have higher per-minute rates. The pricing page (https://www.lyft.com/bikes/bay-wheels/pricing) states that the monthly membership price is $29, and members get 45 minutes free per ride on classic bikes and free unlocks on ebikes, with a reduced per-minute rate of $0.17.
PAY-PER-USE TOTAL: $5104.05
MEMBERSHIP TOTAL: $74.71  (monthly price x months + per-minute charges)
BREAK-EVEN: 3.1 rides per month (actual: 540 rides per month)
WEEKLY TABLE: week | rides | avg minutes | pay-per-use spend
2024-40 | 96 | 12.37 | $953.79
2024-41 | 118 | 9.15 | $1,041.30
2024-42 | 123 | 9.77 | $1,186.45
2024-43 | 121 | 11.85 | $1,185.10
2024-44 | 82 | 9.63 | $737.42
ASSUMPTIONS: The rider's data only covers one month, so the monthly membership price is applied for one month. The per-minute charges for members are calculated based on the reduced rates for classic bikes and free unlocks for ebikes.

sql_log.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rides, COUNT(DISTINCT ride_month) AS distinct_months, SUM(duration_min) AS total_duration_min FROM trips
SELECT rideable_type, COUNT(*) AS rides, SUM(duration_min) AS total_duration_min FROM trips GROUP BY rideable_type ORDER BY rideable_type
SELECT rideable_type, COUNT(*) AS rides, SUM(duration_min) AS total_duration_min FROM trips GROUP BY rideable_type ORDER BY rideable_type
SELECT SUM(U + CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN E ELSE C END * duration_min) AS pay_per_use_total FROM trips, (SELECT 1.00 AS U, 0.19 AS C, 1.00 AS E, 0.49 AS F) AS rates

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ride_month) AS months, SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN Em * MAX(duration_min - F, 0) ELSE Cm * MAX(duration_min - F, 0) END) AS per_minute_charges FROM trips, (SELECT 29 AS monthly_price, 45 AS F, 0.17 AS Cm, 0.17 AS Em) AS membership_rates GROUP BY rideable_type

SELECT ride_week, COUNT(*) AS rides, AVG(duration_min) AS avg_minutes, SUM(U + CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN E ELSE C END * duration_min) AS pay_per_use_spend FROM trips, (SELECT 1.00 AS U, 0.19 AS C, 1.00 AS E, 0.49 AS F) AS rates GROUP BY ride_week ORDER BY ride_week LIMIT 6
